Mac Ignites

Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Website Direction · Third-Party Customer Service
Timeline
2026
Engagement
Project-based, completed
Deliverables
6 core assets

Mac Ignites is a third-party customer-service company that serves clients across industries.

The Problem

It lacked a distinct visual identity and a website. Its previous presentation was generic and informal.

The Strategic Move

Use the identity to build trust through visual clarity.

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Logo and visual identity
  • Brand guidelines
  • Website UI/UX direction
  • Website design/development through a third-party web designer
  • Staff ID cards
Outcome

Mac Ignites replaced a generic, informal look with one system clients now meet everywhere: macignites.com, staff ID cards and branded apparel.

The Mark

A custom 'mac' letterform with a stylized flame built into its own counter, plus a text-free icon variant reserved for favicons and small placements.

Applied

The same system carried onto the things a growing outsourcing team actually hands out: staff ID badges, the app icon, branded apparel.

Typography: Raleway for headlines, Poppins for body copy and web content, both free for commercial use to keep the system easy to hand off. Founder identity, internal strategy, client information, and staff personal data are kept off this page; the ID card shown is a sample layout, not a real staff record.
